api/BOOSEapp.html.summary: Namespace BOOSEapp Classes AppCanvas AppCircle A command that draws a circle on the canvas. AppCommandFactory A singleton factory class for creating custom application commands. AppInt creates integer variable type for BOOSE programs. Stores whole numbers and truncates decimal values. AppMoveTo shows the moveto command which moves the canvas cursor to a new (x, y) position. AppParser Parses BOOSE source code into executable commands. Handles variable and real declarations and assignments. AppReal supports real number variable type for BOOSE programs AppRect This command draws a rectangle on the canvas using width and height in pixels. AppStoredProgram stored program that handles real number variables Extends BOOSE StoredProgram to support AppReal types AppWrite Form1
